text.zh-CN: 产后出血是分娩后失血过多，可迅速影响血液循环。正常产后恶露是逐渐减少的阴道排出物，不能把突然大量出血一概当作正常恶露。
text.en: Postpartum hemorrhage is excessive bleeding after childbirth that can rapidly impair circulation. Normal lochia, the postpartum vaginal discharge, should gradually diminish; sudden heavy bleeding should not be assumed normal.

text.en: WHO 2025 recommends first-response treatment within 24 hours after birth at measured loss of 500 mL, or 300 mL with abnormal circulatory signs, whichever occurs first.

text.zh-CN: 眼科检查要看清视网膜，而不只是测视力或验光。
text.en: Assessment needs a view of the retina, not only a vision or glasses test.

supports.assessment: Author located the specific statement in Dilated eye exam. Source supports the matched component; unresolved compound-claim details remain listed below and require independent review.

text.zh-CN: 医生会问变化何时开始、哪只眼睛、是否有外伤、眼手术及糖尿病史，并检查视力和眼底。
text.en: The clinician asks about timing, the affected eye, injuries, eye operations and diabetes, and examines vision and the back of the eye.

text.zh-CN: 散瞳滴眼液把瞳孔暂时放大，帮助医生检查眼底和周边裂孔。散瞳后可能暂时怕光、模糊，请安排亲友陪同或接送。
text.en: Dilating drops widen the pupil temporarily to help examine the retina and peripheral tears. Temporary blur and light sensitivity can follow; arrange accompaniment or a ride home.

text.en: When blood or another opacity obscures the retina, ocular ultrasound uses sound waves to help assess its position and the extent of detachment.

text.zh-CN: OCT是获取视网膜分层图像的扫描，可帮助判断中心的黄斑是否被积液抬起。它与看不清眼底时使用的超声用途不同，医生按眼内情况选择。
text.en: OCT provides cross-sectional retinal images and can help determine whether fluid has detached the central macula. Its purpose differs from ultrasound used when the view is obscured; selection follows the eye findings.

supports.assessment: Supports only the specific matched component at this locator; independent re-review remains pending.
Same ASRS origin; OCT-specific purpose still lacks a second independent source in this record.

independence.rationale: Distinct named authors/institutions retained, but multiple pages from one organization count once. Presence of two groups at chapter level is not proof for every component; read the claim map and unresolved questions.

dispute.resolution: UK/US sources support the stated principles. NHS111 is a UK route only. Fasting, anesthesia, postoperative drops, posture and activity timings vary by procedure and team; no universal interval, dose, probability or worldwide approval inferred. Macular-hole material used only for shared intraocular-gas safety, not retinal-detachment treatment outcomes.

unresolved_questions: R02 / diagnosis-oct: the purpose of checking central macular fluid is directly ASRS, including its complex-detachment page; these are one editorial group. Need a second independent diagnostic source for that specific use, not another ASRS URL.
diagnosis-2: Mayo now directly supports the full history including diabetes. EyeWiki independently supports timing/prior injury/surgery but does not explicitly repeat the diabetes-specific question.

text.en: Flashes and floaters can result from several changes inside the eye, distinguished by retinal examination.

text.zh-CN: 玻璃体后脱离是眼内凝胶离开视网膜，常随年龄出现。它可能仅造成飞蚊，也可能牵出裂孔，所以新症状需要检查。
text.en: Posterior vitreous detachment means the eye gel separates from the retina with age. It may cause floaters alone or pull a retinal tear, so new symptoms need examination.

text.en: A retinal tear is a break that may precede a larger detachment; sealing an appropriate tear early may limit progression.

text.zh-CN: 糖尿病眼病可使血管出血进入玻璃体（眼内的凝胶），造成飘动黑影或视物模糊；这与瘢痕牵拉视网膜是不同机制。
text.en: Diabetic eye disease can bleed into the vitreous, the gel inside the eye, causing dark floaters or blur. This differs from scar tissue pulling the retina away.

text.en: A sudden curtain or loss of sight still requires immediate assessment; having diabetes does not establish glucose fluctuation as the cause.

text.zh-CN: 治疗目标是保留视力，方法按脱离机制选择。封闭裂口和以下复位手术主要用于裂孔性脱离。
text.en: Treatment aims to preserve sight, with the method chosen by mechanism. Sealing breaks and the repair procedures below mainly concern tear-related detachment.

text.en: Laser or freezing treatment can seal suitable small tears; an established larger detachment usually needs additional surgery.

text.zh-CN: 玻璃体切除术去除牵拉的凝胶，可用气体或硅油支撑；巩膜扣带是在眼球外加支撑，气体复位术适用于部分病例。
text.en: Vitrectomy removes pulling gel and may use gas or silicone oil for support. A scleral buckle supports the eye from outside; gas-based repair suits selected cases.

text.zh-CN: 手术方式取决于脱离位置、范围和瘢痕。复位是把组织放回位置，与视力恢复不是同一结果；成功复位后仍可能遗留视损，有时还需再次手术。
text.en: The operation depends on location, extent and scarring. Reattachment restores tissue position; it is a different outcome from restored sight. Vision loss can persist after successful reattachment, and another operation may be needed.

text.zh-CN: 牵拉性脱离可能需要玻璃体切除术解除牵拉，同时处理糖尿病眼病等基础问题。渗出性脱离没有裂口，需查明并治疗炎症、异常血管或肿瘤等原因，不能套用统一的封口手术。
text.en: Tractional detachment may need vitrectomy to release pulling tissue, alongside care for conditions such as diabetic eye disease. Exudative detachment has no break: treatment addresses causes such as inflammation, abnormal vessels or tumors rather than a uniform break-sealing operation.

text.zh-CN: 眼内气泡未消失时，应避免笑气（一氧化二氮）麻醉或止痛；笑气可使气泡膨胀，并可能损伤视力。
text.en: While gas remains inside the eye, avoid nitrous oxide, or laughing gas, for anesthesia or pain relief: it can enlarge the bubble and threaten vision.

text.en: Before another operation or emergency or labor pain relief, tell the team that gas is inside your eye and show any alert card or wristband. Ambulance staff also need this information.

text.en: Early blur does not automatically mean failure: a bubble and healing can affect the view. Examination determines whether attachment is restored.

text.en: Visual recovery may continue for months. Even after reattachment, some loss may persist, particularly when the macula was detached.

text.zh-CN: 阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）是睡着后上气道反复变窄或关闭，使气流减少或暂停；身体反复醒一下来重新呼吸，睡眠因此被打断。

text.zh-CN: 美国FDA已批准替尔泊肽用于合并肥胖的中重度OSA成人，并配合降低能量摄入和增加活动。它通过体重相关机制改善病情；这项美国适应证不能自动当成其他国家的批准。

text.zh-CN: 替尔泊肽常见不适包括恶心、呕吐、腹泻或便秘；用药前需讨论胰腺、胆囊、肾脏病史及合用降糖药。美国资料规定，有个人或家族髓样甲状腺癌（一种来自特定甲状腺细胞的癌症）病史，或有2型多发性内分泌肿瘤综合征（MEN2，一种遗传性内分泌肿瘤病）者不能使用。
text.en: Tirzepatide may cause nausea, vomiting, diarrhea or constipation. Review pancreatic, gallbladder and kidney history and other glucose-lowering medicines beforehand. US information contraindicates use with a personal or family history of medullary thyroid cancer (a cancer of specific thyroid cells) or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2 (MEN2, an inherited endocrine tumor disorder).

text.zh-CN: 安眠药和镇静止痛药可能影响夜间呼吸。把OSA告诉开药和麻醉团队，按其安排使用或调整；不要自行加量来压住夜间醒来。
text.en: Sleeping medicines and sedating pain medicines can affect breathing. Tell prescribing and anesthesia teams about OSA and follow their plan rather than increasing doses to suppress awakenings.

text.zh-CN: 正在使用替尔泊肽时，手术或深镇静检查前还要主动报出药名。药物会让胃排空变慢，麻醉时胃内容物进入肺部的风险可能增加；由麻醉和开药团队安排用药及饮食，不自行套用停药天数。
text.en: If taking tirzepatide, name the medicine before surgery or deep sedation. Slower stomach emptying can increase the risk of stomach contents entering the lungs during anesthesia; the anesthesia and prescribing teams should plan medication and food instructions rather than a self-chosen stopping interval.

text.zh-CN: 妊娠期不要使用替尔泊肽；用药中发现怀孕，应停药并联系开药医生。准备怀孕时，提前讨论停药和避孕安排，不自行套用其他减重药的停药时间。
text.en: Do not use tirzepatide during pregnancy. If pregnancy is recognized, stop it and contact the prescriber. Discuss medication and contraception plans before trying to conceive; stopping intervals differ between medicines.

text.zh-CN: 口服避孕药可能受替尔泊肽影响而降低效果。开始用药后4周、每次增加剂量后4周，需加用避孕套等屏障避孕，或与医生商定改用非口服避孕方式；更换方式时确认何时开始有效。
text.en: Tirzepatide can reduce oral contraceptive effectiveness. For 4 weeks after starting and 4 weeks after each dose increase, add a barrier such as condoms or arrange non-oral contraception. Check when a changed method becomes effective.

text.zh-CN: 缓解疼痛与处理病因是两个目标，治疗强度由具体问题决定。
text.en: Relieving pain and treating its cause are separate goals; the underlying problem determines treatment intensity.

text.zh-CN: 已判断为轻症时可休息、补液并观察；病毒性胃肠炎重点补回丢失的水和电解质，电解质就是身体需要维持平衡的盐类。便秘或反流则采用各自的治疗。
text.en: Mild assessed illness may need rest, fluids and observation. Viral gastroenteritis focuses on replacing water and electrolytes, the salts needed for normal body balance. Constipation and reflux follow their own treatments.

text.zh-CN: 没有一种止痛药或胃药适合所有腹痛，先确认原因和适用条件。
text.en: No painkiller or stomach medicine fits every abdominal pain; establish the cause and circumstances first.

text.zh-CN: 明确为消化不良时可讨论抗酸药，肠道痉挛时医生可能考虑解痉药；这与感染、结石或急需手术的问题不是同一种治疗。
text.en: Antacids may suit established indigestion, while an antispasmodic may help selected bowel spasms. These are different from treating infection, stones or a surgical emergency.

text.zh-CN: 对新出现、原因未明的腹痛，先咨询药师或医生再选止痛药。澳大利亚Healthdirect针对12岁以上人群提醒，阿司匹林和布洛芬等抗炎药可刺激胃肠；其说明另将经痛区分处理。
text.en: For new unexplained pain, ask a pharmacist or clinician before choosing pain relief. Healthdirect advice for people over 12 warns that aspirin and anti-inflammatory medicines such as ibuprofen can irritate the gut; it distinguishes period pain from other abdominal pain.

text.zh-CN: 若腹泻带血或伴发热，不自行用止泻药压住症状，应就医查原因；儿童使用止泻药也需先问医生。这些限制针对腹泻处理，不是所有腹痛都需要止泻药。

text.zh-CN: 先按病因选择饮食，不能把所有腹痛都变成禁食或统一清淡食谱。
text.en: Choose food by cause rather than assigning fasting or one restrictive diet to every abdominal pain.

supports.assessment: Passage supports relevant cause, condition or action in: Choose food by cause rather than assigning fasting or one restrictive diet to every abdominal pain.

text.zh-CN: 病毒性胃肠炎呕吐时，可小口、分次喝液体；食欲恢复后通常能逐步回到平常饮食。儿童需要时按医疗建议使用口服补液盐，婴儿通常继续母乳或配方奶。
text.en: With vomiting from viral gastroenteritis, take small, repeated sips. Usual food can generally resume as appetite returns. Children may need oral rehydration solution under guidance; infants generally continue breast milk or formula.

text.en: The same complaint needs different assessment in children, pregnancy and people with other illness.

text.zh-CN: 儿童可能只表现为哭闹、拒绝活动、食欲下降，未必说清位置。精神很差、拒绝喝水、绿色呕吐或血便应尽快就诊，不直接套用成人居家方案。
text.en: Children may cry, refuse movement or lose appetite without locating pain clearly. Marked illness, refusing fluids, green vomit or blood in stool needs prompt care rather than an adult home-care plan.

text.zh-CN: 妊娠可能或已经怀孕时，应把这一点告诉医生；腹痛伴异常阴道出血需及时评估。普通的便秘或反流也可发生，但不能先入为主排除妊娠相关问题。
text.en: Tell the clinician about possible or confirmed pregnancy; pain with unusual vaginal bleeding needs timely assessment. Constipation or reflux can coexist without excluding a pregnancy-related problem.

text.en: Older people, those with impaired immunity or severe diarrhea need particular attention to dehydration; oral rehydration solution may be advised. Thirst, changing urine output or inability to maintain fluids warrants medical advice on replacement.

text.zh-CN: 腹痛没有统一恢复时间，原因和后续变化决定是否需要复查。
text.en: There is no single recovery time; the cause and subsequent changes determine review.

text.zh-CN: 轻症可能数小时至数天改善。未改善、反复发作或影响饮食与活动，带记录复诊；体重下降、出血、排便改变等也需重新检查。
text.en: Mild episodes may ease over hours to days. Review persistent, recurrent or disruptive symptoms with your record; weight loss, bleeding or altered bowel habits also need reassessment.

text.en: Ask how results will be returned and when review is due, as some tests take time. In children without an initial clear cause, newly localized pain or reluctance to move can change the assessment.
